about: What CI runs for each planner group, as bin/ci-local.py runs it on a developer machine.
Jobs run in this order. Each CI step is listed under steps (run here), setup
(installs and probes this machine is expected to have done) or left_to_ci
(what only CI can run, as the report names it). A step's run is the CI command,
or the CI command's lines in order without its installs. needs names what
must be installed for a step to run here: a path, pip:NAME, or pip:-r FILE;
when something is missing the step is left to CI. tests/test_ci_workflow.py
keeps this table and .github/workflows/ci.yml in step.

setup: Require renderer dependencies for shell coverage

steps.Syntax check — all shell scripts:
FAIL=0
for f in bin/*.sh bin/lib/*.sh; do
  if ! bash -n "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "FAIL: $f"
    FAIL=1
  fi
done
exit $FAIL
steps.No hardcoded internal references:
# Check bin/ scripts for Curve-Labs references (should be parameterized)
FOUND=$(grep -rn "Curve-Labs\|curve-labs\|curvelabs" bin/ --include='*.sh' | grep -v 'test-' || true)
if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
  echo "Found internal references in bin/ scripts:"
  echo "$FOUND"
  exit 1
fi
steps.No unsafe .env sourcing:
FOUND=$(grep -rn 'source.*\.env' bin/ --include='*.sh' | grep -v 'test-' | grep -v '#' || true)
if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
  echo "Found unsafe 'source .env':"
  echo "$FOUND"
  exit 1
fi
steps.No echo or printf piped into grep -q und:
FOUND=$(grep -l pipefail bin/tests/*.sh tests/*.sh | xargs grep -nE '(printf .%s[^ ]*|echo) .\$[^ ]* \| *grep -[A-Za-z]*q' | grep -vE '^[^:]+:[0-9]+: *#' || true)
if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
  echo "Found a pipe into grep -q under pipefail (use grep -q PATTERN <<< \"\$VAR\"):"
  echo "$FOUND"
  exit 1
fi
steps.No manual JSON construction:
FOUND=$(grep -rn '"{\\\"' bin/ --include='*.sh' | grep -v 'test-' || true)
if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
  echo "Found manual JSON construction (use jq -n):"
  echo "$FOUND"
  exit 1
fi
steps.Local mode graceful degradation:
FAIL=0
for script in bin/graph.sh bin/notify.sh bin/graph-op.sh; do
  if [ -f "$script" ] && ! grep -q '"local"' "$script" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "FAIL: $script missing local mode handling"
    FAIL=1
  fi
done
exit $FAIL
steps.Commands have valid structure:
FAIL=0
COMMAND_FILES=$(find .claude/commands -name '*.md' -type f 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$COMMAND_FILES" ]; then
  COMMAND_FILES=$(find .claude/skills -name 'SKILL.md' -type f 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
if [ -z "$COMMAND_FILES" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: no Claude command or skill files found"
  exit 1
fi
while IFS= read -r cmd; do
  [ -n "$cmd" ] || continue
  # Every command should have content (not empty)
  LINES=$(wc -l < "$cmd" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "$LINES" -lt 3 ]; then
    echo "FAIL: $cmd is too short ($LINES lines)"
    FAIL=1
  fi
done <<< "$COMMAND_FILES"
echo "Checked $(echo "$COMMAND_FILES" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') command/skill files"
exit $FAIL
